description: This file contains cryptographic functions implementing 64-bit CFB mode encryption/decryption for 3DES (Triple DES) in the BoringSSL library, specifically the 'des/cfb64ede.c' implementation.

methods.name: DES_ede3_cfb64_encrypt
methods.description: Performs 64-bit CFB mode encryption or decryption for 3DES, handling input/output data with internal state.

methods.name: DES_ede3_cfb_encrypt
methods.description: Performs variable-bit CFB mode encryption or decryption for 3DES, supporting different segment sizes (numbits).
